_comment: Maps the TED buyer main-activity field (eForms authority-activity codes and their common textual variants, matched case-insensitively on the folded string) to sector groups for H4. PROXY WARNING (must be repeated in outputs): NIS2 'newly in scope' status of the buyer is NOT observable on TED; buyer main activity is a coarse proxy for the sector split, and many buyers (municipalities...) report 'general public services' regardless of function. annex: 'I' = sectors of high criticality (NIS2 Annex I), 'II' = other critical sectors (Annex II), null = not attributable. risk_zone: NIS360 risk-zone sectors flagged per the thesis spec: ICT service management, space, public administration, maritime transport, health, gas.
_h4_note: H4 splits: (a) risk_zone true vs false; (b) annex I vs II - Annex II coverage among public buyers on TED is thin (postal, waste, chemicals, food, digital providers are mostly private), so the annex split is expected to be underpowered; report it with that caveat.
